extracted.name: Easy Blender Salsa
extracted.description: Made in a flash by using the blender, this zesty salsa is seasoned with jalapeño pepper, onion, cilantro, and lemon juice.
ingredient_lines: 1 jalapeno chile, seeds and ribs removed
1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice, or to taste
instruction_lines: Pour 1 can of tomatoes into a blender; add jalapeño pepper, onion, cilantro leaves, lemon juice, and salt. Blend until fairly smooth. Pour in second can of tomatoes and blend briefly. Adjust seasonings to taste by adding more lemon juice and salt. Let salsa rest for 1/2 hour before serving to allow flavors to blend.
